blocks.text: TURIN, Italy— Ben Shelton tried coming forward. He tried staying back. He served-and-volleyed. He resorted to coming in on his second shot. None of it was quite enough in the American’s attempt to make a breakthrough against Alexander Zverev. The top-ranked Zverev was impeccable on his serve and improved to 7-0 in his career against Shelton with a 6-2, 7-6 (4) victory at the ATP Finals on Tuesday in a rematch of the U.S. Open final.
